description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'Setting' within the OpenCart admin module, specifically for handling catalog settings tasks. It includes methods for generating setting task lists, managing store-specific configurations, and clearing generated JSON files related to store settings.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: A controller class for managing catalog settings tasks, including generating task lists, storing settings as JSON files, and clearing those files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of setting-related tasks for the catalog, including clearing old tasks and assigning store/language specific tasks.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Generates a JSON configuration file for a specific store, incorporating store details, language, country, zone, currency, and other settings.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes the generated JSON configuration file for a specific store, based on its URL and language.
